svg.text: MHA / GQA / MQA · SAME 8 QUERY HEADS
One Q head per KV group
Four Q heads per KV group
All Q heads share one K/V
Blue: Q head · gold: one K head and one V head. Lines show pairing / sharing.
Each Q head still computes its own attention weights.
Schematic head counts, not model layer counts. Llama 2 7B uses 32Q / 32KV; Qwen2-7B uses 28Q / 4KV.
